title: A shared layout
description:
Design a struct that two different programs can share in memory safely.

```
SharedHeader: 32 bytes
  magic     @0  (4)
  version   @4  (4)
  size      @8  (8)
  writerPid @16 (4)
  flags     @20 (4)
  reserved  @24 (8)
all offsets checked at compile time
```
hints: `static_assert(offsetof(SharedHeader, size) == 8);` breaks the build if someone reorders the fields (lesson 3.02).
A 64-bit field should sit at an offset that is a multiple of 8 in both 32-bit and 64-bit programs.
requirements: Only fixed-width types (`std::uint32_t`, `std::uint64_t`), no pointers, no `std::string`.
A magic number and a version so a reader can refuse a layout it does not know.
stretch: Add an array of 16 fixed-size records after the header and check its offset too.
